info.title: Crave Storefront API
info.description: Direct public Storefront API. Anonymous catalog reads require no API key. Protected resources use purpose-limited cart, checkout, receipt, or customer credentials.

servers.description: Sandbox Storefront API. The origin is supplied by generated project configuration (`apiBaseUrl`) rather than defaulted here, so a template can never ship pointing at an environment its owner did not choose.
